title: Democratic inputs to AI
summary: Our nonprofit organization, OpenAI, Inc., is launching a program to award ten $100,000 grants to fund experiments in setting up a democratic process for deciding what rules AI systems should follow, within the bounds defined by the law.
body: Our nonprofit organization, OpenAI, Inc., is launching a program to award ten $100,000 grants to fund experiments in setting up a democratic process for deciding what rules AI systems should follow, within the bounds defined by the law.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布启动一项资助计划，提供10个10万美元的资助名额，用于资助关于建立民主程序以决定AI系统行为准则的实验探索，确保AI规则制定符合公众意愿并在法律框架内运行。原始信息显示：Our nonprofit organization, OpenAI, Inc., is launching a program to award ten $100,000 grants to fund experiments in setting up a democratic process for deciding what rules AI systems should follow, within the bounds defined by the law.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Democratic inputs to AI”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI资助民主化AI规则制定实验，涉及AI治理与公信力方向的重要实践。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
